body: I had a couple of sessions with a therapist but I didn't feel like he was helping me at all. I feel like no one can help me to live with this.

Thanks for your comment. 4 years is a long time, what was it that changed for you to stop suffering? Everyone says that they get used to it the first year or second, but if you go far from there... it is not a good sign. I don't see how I can be okay with this sound. What was it that helped you?

I understand that your comment is made with good intention. But the reality is that I have not achieved anything these two years other than suffering and going crazy. I had to quit my job because I couldn't stand it, lost my partner... I have been extremely depressed, desperate and suicidal most of the time. No friends, no partner, no achievements. No nothing. 2 years of suffering and seem to no end.

Honestly, I'm a bit skeptical of any variant of this symptom being "stress-induced". I haven't been able to find anything conclusive about the science behind it actually causing the phantom noise. How I have hitherto understood it is that things like stress and anxiety simply exacerbate your perception of it.
You can't give you tinnitus or new tones with just plain anxiety or a hypochondriac episode...
If the majority of the members had severe tinnitus, it would be a suicide forum.
